name: domain-check
description: Does the Domain on a Startup Universe row belong to that company? Judged by reading the site against the company's sector and investors. Catches wrong domains before they feed ATS detection and polling.
instruction: Open https://<Domain> with WebFetch and read what the site says the company does. Decide whether this site belongs to the company in the entry, given its name, sector and investors. Only use a WebSearch if the site is unreachable or says nothing useful. Answer: Confirmed when the site clearly is this company (name matches and the business fits the sector or investors); Wrong when the site is clearly a different business or an unrelated parked page; Suspect when the name matches but the business does not fit, or the site now belongs to an acquirer or a rebrand; Unclear when the site cannot be read. In evidence, quote the site's own description of itself in a few words and say what matched or did not.
